paper.title_en: Gravitational waves from the early universe
paper.abstract_en: Even though different models could already be constrained using CMB data, these models remained unconstrained at higher frequency scales, and, therefore, the knowledge of new physics at these scales remained limited, relying on theoretical assumptions and extrapolations. Recently, however, we experienced the advent of gravitational-wave and multi-messenger astronomy, including the outstanding detections by the LIGO-Virgo collaboration and the searches for Hellings-Downs correlations in pulsar timing data. Over the next decades, ongoing and future collaborations will explore different frequency ranges of the gravitational wave spectrum, granting access to regimes inaccessible by the CMB and collider experiments. These include ground-based, space-borne, and pulsar timing array searches for gravitational waves. By comparing their data with model-dependent gravitational-wave predictions, we can unprecedentedly constrain or eliminate different models or even discover new physics. In these lecture notes, as an entrance door for graduate students, we focus on how we can search for a cosmological background of gravitational waves and how this can be used to probe cosmology and beyond-Standard-Model physics. For this purpose, we review the formalism of gravitational waves in General Relativity, introduce stochastic background gravitational waves, and derive the Hellings-Downs correlation for pulsar timing array searches. We comment on detection efforts and present some of the most important cosmological sources that could produce such a background. These lecture notes were inspired by the course "Gravitational Waves from the Early Universe" given at the 27th W.E. Heraeus "Saalburg" Summer School 2021 by Valerie Domcke.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文为研究生讲义，系统介绍了利用引力波探测宇宙早期物理的方法，重点涵盖随机引力波背景、Hellings-Downs关联及脉冲星计时阵列搜索，与PTA主题高度相关，内容深入且具有教学价值。
decision.title_zh: 来自早期宇宙的引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 尽管已有不同模型可以通过CMB数据进行约束，但这些模型在更高频率尺度上仍未受到限制，因此，对这些尺度上新物理的认识仍然有限，依赖于理论假设和外推。然而，最近我们经历了引力波和多信使天文学的到来，包括LIGO-Virgo合作的杰出探测以及对脉冲星计时数据中Hellings-Downs关联的搜索。在未来几十年中，正在进行和未来的合作将探索引力波谱的不同频率范围，从而进入CMB和对撞机实验无法触及的区域。这些包括地基、天基和脉冲星计时阵列对引力波的搜索。通过将它们的观测数据与依赖于模型的引力波预言进行比较，我们可以空前地约束或排除不同的模型，甚至发现新物理。在这些讲义中，作为研究生入门指南，我们聚焦于如何搜索宇宙学引力波背景，以及如何利用它来探测宇宙学和超出标准模型的新物理。为此，我们回顾了广义相对论中引力波的形式论，介绍了随机背景引力波，并推导了脉冲星计时阵列搜索的Hellings-Downs关联。我们评论了探测工作，并介绍了一些可能产生这种背景的最重要的宇宙学源。这些讲义受Valerie Domcke在2021年第27届W.E. Heraeus“Saalburg”暑期学校所开设的“来自早期宇宙的引力波”课程的启发。
decision.translation_warning: 注意：原文标注为课程讲义，但内容为全面的科学综述，翻译用时注意保持术语一致性。
